From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we\u2019re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we\u2019ll map a new way forward. Working together, we\u2019ll create a future that\u2019s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1><strong><u>Role Summary<\/u><\/strong><\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.<\/p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><h1><strong><u>Responsibilities<\/u><\/strong><\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><h1><strong><u>Qualifications<\/u><\/strong><\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><u>Minimum Qualifications: <\/u><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep experience with serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers, including designing schemas with strict backward and forward compatibility guarantees for devices you cannot force-update.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong Python and working C literacy; real depth in a modern build system such as Bazel, including writing rules and repository-level integration, not just consuming builds.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Mature CI\/CD and release engineering judgment: you design validation gates and rollout mechanics that encode correctness in automation, and you know which guarantees belong in tooling versus process.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Sound judgment under production pressure: you can lead a time-critical fix during a vehicle launch, and you also know when to refuse a shortcut or fence one in and drive its removal afterward.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Excellent written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to non-software audiences and to write decision documents that hold up over time.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The instinct to lead through leverage: you measure your impact by what the team and its users can do without you.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><u>Preferred Qualifications<\/u><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Automotive or embedded domain experience: UDS diagnostics, vehicle variant coding, factory provisioning, or OTA update style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Familiarity with manifest-based multi-repository workflows.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h2><strong><u>Total Rewards<\/u><\/strong><\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We build the flex-col gap-1 empty:hidden\">\n<div class=\"markdown prose dark:prose-invert wrap-break-word w-full light markdown-new-styling\">\n<p class=\"\" data-start=\"0\" data-end=\"395\">Wolt ist im August 2020 in Deutschland gestartet und hat zun\u00e4chst Kund:innen in Berlin mit gro\u00dfartigen lokalen Restaurants verbunden. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer f\u00fchrenden Plattform f\u00fcr lokalen Handel entwickelt \u2013 und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln \u00fcber Blumen und Home-&amp;-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haust\u00fcr unserer Kund:innen.<\/p>\n<p data-start=\"397\" data-end=\"839\">Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt w\u00e4chst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit <strong data-start=\"634\" data-end=\"654\">MediaMarktSaturn<\/strong> gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel \u2013 von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen \u2013 k\u00f6nnen in gro\u00dfen deutschen St\u00e4dten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.<\/p>\n<p data-start=\"841\" data-end=\"1203\">Wir bauen unser Retail-Gesch\u00e4ft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.<\/p>\n<p data-start=\"1205\" data-end=\"1518\" data-is-last-node=\"\" data-is-only-node=\"\">Erfahre mehr \u00fcber unsere Partnerschaft mit <a class=\"decorated-link\" href=\"https:\/\/press.wolt.com\/de-DE\/268011-mediamarktsaturn-startet-auf-wolt-vom-smartphone-bis-zur-spielkonsole-technik-in-rund-35-minuten-geliefert\/?utm_source=chatgpt.com\" target=\"_new\" data-start=\"1248\" data-end=\"1411\">MediaMarktSaturn<\/a> und entdecke die neuesten Updates im <a class=\"decorated-link\" href=\"https:\/\/press.wolt.com\/de-DE\/tags\/news\/?utm_source=chatgpt.com\" target=\"_new\" data-start=\"1449\" data-end=\"1517\">Wolt Deutschland Newsroom<\/a>.<\/p>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/section>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/header>\n<div class=\"block-wrapper\">\n<div class=\"max-w-lg block-content max-w-applicationForm\">\n<div class=\"job-detail-client-module__HnVBZW__wysiwygContainer grid grid-cols-1 justify-items-center\">\n<div class=\"wysiwyg mb-8 md:mb-10 lg:mb-12\">\n<h2><strong>Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt<\/strong><\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Identifikation &amp; Akquise:<\/strong> Du bist verantwortlich f\u00fcr das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Superm\u00e4rkte und erstklassige Non-Food-Venues im Raum Berlin zu gewinnen und diese zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Pipeline-Management:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenst\u00e4ndig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Gesch\u00e4ftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.<\/li>\n<li><strong>\u00dcberzeugende Pr\u00e4sentation:&nbsp;<\/strong>Du positionierst Wolt als f\u00fchrende E-Commerce-L\u00f6sung. Dabei h\u00f6rst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und \u00fcberzeugst Entscheidungstr\u00e4ger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Pr\u00e4senz vor Ort:&nbsp;<\/strong>Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Au\u00dfendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1\u20132 Tagen strategischer Planung und Cold Calling (Home Office) sowie 3\u20134 Tagen im Au\u00dfendienst in Berlin (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotel\u00fcbernachtungen).<\/li>\n<li><strong>Schnittstellenarbeit:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner \u2013 vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen \u2013 auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2><strong>Das bringst du mit:<\/strong><\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Vertriebsprofi im Au\u00dfendienst:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du hast bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales und liebst den Kaltkundenkontakt. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu \u00fcberzeugen.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Hohe Anpassungsf\u00e4higkeit:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du kommunizierst souver\u00e4n auf Augenh\u00f6he \u2013 vom Blumenladen bis zum&nbsp;<strong>C-Level-Entscheider<\/strong>. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Performance-Drive:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du willst der Beste sein und die&nbsp;<strong>Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt<\/strong>&nbsp;f\u00fcr Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Selbstorganisation:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du planst deine&nbsp;<strong>Walk-in-Routen<\/strong>&nbsp;effizient, trackst deine Aktivit\u00e4ten eigenst\u00e4ndig und managest deine Pipeline absolut zuverl\u00e4ssig.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Positives Mindset:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du bist hartn\u00e4ckig, denkst l\u00f6sungsorientiert und beh\u00e4ltst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Qualifikation &amp; Sprache:<\/strong>&nbsp;Studium oder Ausbildung,&nbsp;<strong>flie\u00dfendes Deutsch<\/strong>&nbsp;und gute Englischkenntnisse.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2><strong>Was wir dir anbieten:<\/strong><\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Gestalte die Zukunft des Handels:<\/strong>&nbsp;Wir ver\u00e4ndern, wie Menschen einkaufen. Dein Job ist es, den lokalen Handel so effizient zu machen, dass unsere Kunden Zeit f\u00fcr Wichtigeres gewinnen, anstatt sie in Warteschlangen im Supermarkt zu verbringen.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Wachstum &amp; Impact:<\/strong> Nutze die steile Lernkurve eines globalen Tech-Unternehmens und entwickle unsere bereits etablierten M\u00e4rkte in Berlin auf das n\u00e4chste Level.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Eigenverantwortung:<\/strong>&nbsp;Arbeite selbst\u00e4ndig in einem dynamischen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direktem Einfluss auf den Markterfolg.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Mobilit\u00e4t &amp; Equipment:<\/strong>&nbsp;Du erh\u00e4ltst Top-Hardware (iPhone &amp; MacBook) und die Option auf einen&nbsp;<strong>Firmenwagen<\/strong>&nbsp;f\u00fcr deine Eins\u00e4tze im Au\u00dfendienst.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Wolt-Benefits:<\/strong>&nbsp;Rabatte auf Wolt-Bestellungen, \u00d6PNV-Zuschuss sowie Wellness-Angebote (z. B. Urban Sports Club).<\/li>\n<li><strong>Work-Life-Balance:<\/strong>&nbsp;30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten.&nbsp;<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2><strong>N\u00e4chste Schritte<\/strong><\/h2>\n<p>Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist unkompliziert und transparent:<\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Recruiter Screening:<\/strong>&nbsp;Ein erstes Gespr\u00e4ch mit unserem&nbsp;<strong>Recruiting-Team<\/strong>, um dich, deine bisherige Erfahrung und deine Motivation f\u00fcr Wolt kennenzulernen.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Hiring Manager Interview:<\/strong>&nbsp;Ein vertiefendes Gespr\u00e4ch mit dem&nbsp;<strong>Hiring Manager<\/strong>, in dem wir mehr \u00fcber deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Motivation f\u00fcr die Rolle erfahren m\u00f6chten.<\/li>\n<li><strong>Role Play:<\/strong>&nbsp;Eine praxisnahe&nbsp;<strong>Sales-\u00dcbung<\/strong>, bei der du uns deinen Ansatz bei der Kundenansprache, im Pitch und im Umgang mit Einw\u00e4nden zeigen kannst.<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2><strong>Bereit, mit uns Geschichte zu schreiben?<\/strong><\/h2>\n<p>Wir ver\u00e4ndern nicht nur den Handel \u2013 wir geben den Menschen Zeit f\u00fcr das zur\u00fcck, was sie wirklich lieben. Wenn du in einem High-Growth-Umfeld Verantwortung \u00fcbernehmen willst und ein Team suchst, das Ambition mit Spa\u00df verbindet, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam den Markt revolutionieren!<\/strong><\/p>\n<p><strong><em>Wichtiger Hinweis:<\/em><\/strong><em>&nbsp;Um deine Daten bestm\u00f6glich zu sch\u00fctzen (GDPR), akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze ausschlie\u00dflich unsere Karriereseite f\u00fcr deine Bewerbung. Your primary focus is proactive, high-velocity sourcing of qualified, diverse candidates and driving end-to-end hiring excellence.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do (Role Expectations)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own full-cycle recruiting with business leaders across EMEA, managing the process from intake and calibration to the final close&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead with sourcing by building net-new pipelines via LinkedIn Recruiter, talent maps, and targeted campaigns to maintain 2\u20133x pipeline coverage per role&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner directly with VPs, Directors and Managers to forecast demand, define profiles, calibrate market compensation, and advise on process trade-offs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive structured, efficient hiring cycles by managing scorecards, interview plans, and data hygiene to ensure a high-quality candidate experience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deliver weekly updates on pipeline health and status of openings, diagnosing and fixing bottlenecks to maintain hiring momentum&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are (Success Profile)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You thrive in ambiguity. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You act like an owner. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We\u2019re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Foundational understanding of AI\/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in B2B SaaS, with a good understanding of cybersecurity, networking and cloud technologies and excellent written and verbal communication skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven success sourcing and converting passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter and modern talent discovery tools&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Track record of meeting or exceeding goals for quality, time-to-fill, and offer acceptance goals while managing 8\u201312 concurrent searches&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in structured interview techniques, compensation fundamentals, and complex offer negotiations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience hiring within the cybersecurity or networking industries across a variety of disciplines - engineering, customer success and G&amp;amp;A&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience with sourcing enhancers like Gem or SeekOut, talent intelligence, and detailed market mapping&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated impact on diversity sourcing initiatives and the calibration of interview teams to drive inclusive hiring&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Built hiring playbooks, dashboards, or programs for GTM scale-ups.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working remotely as only TA person on the ground in region&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Have worked for high growth US tech company&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p data-pm-slice=&quot;1 3 []&quot;&gt;At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Customers and users across the globe use Planet&#39;s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world\u2019s toughest obstacles.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role:&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Director of Sales, Europe will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet\u2019s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports\u2014fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet\u2019s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors\/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000; background-color: transparent;&quot;&gt;This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Kingdom or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Impact You\u2019ll Own:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Forecast Governance &amp;amp; Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Capture Strategy &amp;amp; Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage, Coach &amp;amp; Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Talent Bench &amp;amp; Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technical &amp;amp; Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales\/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deal Cadence &amp;amp; Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Bring:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory \/ leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extensive background navigating complex government, NATO, and defense In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we\u2019re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you\u2019ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Working at Wolt isn\u2019t always easy, but it\u2019s definitely exciting. Here you\u2019ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You\u2019ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you\u2019re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2 class=&quot;PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer&quot; data-section-id=&quot;jfepdd&quot; data-start=&quot;503&quot; data-end=&quot;516&quot;&gt;Who We Are&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p data-start=&quot;518&quot; data-end=&quot;653&quot;&gt;Global Marts builds the technology behind DoorDash&#39;s own grocery and retail operations across DashMart, Wolt Market, and Deliveroo Hop.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p data-start=&quot;655&quot; data-end=&quot;829&quot;&gt;Our systems decide what products our stores stock, how much inventory to purchase, which vendors to source from, how warehouses execute orders, and what prices customers see.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p data-start=&quot;831&quot; data-end=&quot;1092&quot;&gt;We build everything from forecasting and replenishment systems to vendor management, warehouse execution, labor scheduling, space optimization, and pricing. Our in-house forecasting platform has replaced third-party solutions and now powers production globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p data-start=&quot;1094&quot; data-end=&quot;1249&quot;&gt;This isn&#39;t a traditional CRUD backend environment. Much of our work involves designing new systems that solve complex operational problems at global scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p data-start=&quot;1094&quot; data-end=&quot;1249&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2 data-section-id=&quot;11vcmyo&quot; data-start=&quot;0&quot; data-end=&quot;395&quot;&gt;Wolt ist im August 2020 in Deutschland gestartet und hat zun\u00e4chst Kund:innen in Berlin mit gro\u00dfartigen lokalen Restaurants verbunden. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer f\u00fchrenden Plattform f\u00fcr lokalen Handel entwickelt \u2013 und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln \u00fcber Blumen und Home-&amp;amp;-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haust\u00fcr unserer Kund:innen.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p data-start=&quot;397&quot; data-end=&quot;839&quot;&gt;Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt w\u00e4chst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit &lt;strong data-start=&quot;634&quot; data-end=&quot;654&quot;&gt;MediaMarktSaturn&lt;\/strong&gt; gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel \u2013 von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen \u2013 k\u00f6nnen in gro\u00dfen deutschen St\u00e4dten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p data-start=&quot;841&quot; data-end=&quot;1203&quot;&gt;Wir bauen unser Retail-Gesch\u00e4ft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. At Wiz, you\u2019ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. In this role, you will act as a technical leader and people manager\u2014providing strategic direction, mentorship, and operational excellence while staying close to modern cloud and container technologies across AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will build deep partnerships with Software Development, DevOps, and Product Management teams to embed secure-by-design principles into developer workflows, drive proactive vulnerability management, and champion our internal dogfooding program to assess, monitor, and influence product roadmaps.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Team Leadership &amp;amp; Talent Development: Recruit, retain, develop, and coach a high-performing, globally distributed team of Security Engineers; establish performance goals, conduct 1:1s, and support career progression.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technical Strategy &amp;amp; Architecture: Lead threat modeling and technical security reviews across product architectures and multi-cloud infrastructure to identify attack surfaces and design scalable mitigation strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Security Automation &amp;amp; &quot;Shift-Left&quot;: Drive the creation of automation, policy-as-code, and developer-friendly security tooling to integrate continuous, end-to-end security checks into CI\/CD workflows.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Infrastructure &amp;amp; Container Hardening: Define, implement, and govern secure baselines for multi-cloud resources and managed Kubernetes infrastructure (EKS, GKE, AKS).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Vulnerability &amp;amp; Supply Chain Management: Oversee end-to-end vulnerability management and remediation programs, establishing preventative controls across software supply chains from development to production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Detection &amp;amp; Incident Response: Partner with detection and response functions to scale alert triage, investigation capabilities, and automated incident remediation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cross-Functional Partnership: Build deep functional relationships with Engineering and DevOps leadership to balance security requirements with product delivery velocity.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Minimum qualifications&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leadership Experience: 2+ years of experience leading, managing, or mentoring security engineering, DevOps, or technical cloud infrastructure teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience in security engineering or security operations within cloud-native environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cloud &amp;amp; Container Security: Strong hands-on cloud security experience in AWS (with working knowledge of Azure or GCP), along with deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS\/GKE\/AKS) and container security principles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identity &amp;amp; Access Management: In-depth understanding of cloud IAM architecture and identity security at enterprise scale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Infrastructure as Code &amp;amp; Automation: Hands-on experience with IaC frameworks (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, or Pulumi) and automation scripting\/tooling in Python, Go, Shell, HCL, or Rego.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Application Security: Practical knowledge of web application security fundamentals and threat modeling (e.g., OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred qualifications&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience managing and scaling remote, globally distributed engineering teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prior experience in organizations that develop and operate large-scale SaaS or managed cloud services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CIEM, or CDR platforms and methodologies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW149741735 BCX0&quot; The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About WIZE&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WIZE is the leading all-in-one Portfolio Management System for Swiss boutique wealth managers, External Asset Managers, and family offices. Founded in Geneva in 2010, WIZE has earned a trusted position in a relationship-driven market through deep product capability and a differentiated back-office outsourcing service that competitors have not replicated. The company operates on a highly recurring subscription model, holds a strong position within its vertical, and is in excellent operating shape. WIZE is now entering its first chapter of international ownership under Banyan Software, combining more than fifteen years of product depth and client trust with the operational and AI expertise of a global software group.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Opportunity&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will join WIZE directly as Managing Director,&amp;nbsp; United Kingdom, reporting to the CEO of WIZE, with responsibility for establishing and growing the UK business. This is a value-creation mandate, not a turnaround. . You will take the business into a new market, with the United Kingdom as the primary prize. The product has to remain the primary competitive advantage, the recurring revenue base has to be protected, and the opportunity to create structural distance through AI is real.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own the UK client and partner relationships, build the commercial motion from the ground up, and partner with the CEO and product and technology leader to ensure the platform addresses the needs of the UK market.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will have substantial authority over the execution of the agreed UK strategy. Key commercial development decisions, including market positioning, target segments, pricing, partnerships, resource allocation, and major commercial commitments, will be decided jointly with the CEO.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will do this with the long-term backing of a permanent-capital owner, free from the pressure to flip the business.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Will Own&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Commercial &amp;amp; Revenue Growth&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build the foundation of the UK subsidiary and work closely with the CEO to define WIZE&#39;s expansion into the UK market.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the execution of WIZE&#39;s UK strategy, market positioning, and competitive response in the wealth management software market.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive UK revenue and ARR growth with direct accountability across new customer acquisition, expansion, pricing execution, and the development of recurring revenue.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and execute the UK go-to-market motion from the ground up: local presence, bank and partner relationships, and a repeatable pipeline where little exists today.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the primary executive relationship owner for key UK clients, bank partners, and influencers, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and contract renewal.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and deepen strategic partnerships across private banks, discretionary fund managers, and the wider UK wealth management ecosystem.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Anticipate client needs and proactively identify opportunities to expand the company&#39;s footprint within existing UK&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify AI-driven opportunities to reposition the product and create durable competitive distance within the WealthTech vertical, working with the CEO and product and technology leader to assess and prioritise them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Product &amp;amp; Technology&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Represent the needs of the UK market in product roadmap discussions, ensuring that market feedback reflects the needs of boutique wealth managers and the competitive dynamics of the Portfolio Management Systems market.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to a credible AI roadmap. AI must be embedded as a genuine operational and product advantage, not a roadmap line item.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Champion AI-first product thinking, identifying where automation, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows create durable differentiation for UK clients.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner closely with the CEO and CPTO so that the roadmap, packaging, and pricing tiers align tightly with UK commercial needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Gather structured feedback from UK prospects, clients, and partners and translate it into clear commercial and product recommendations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Team &amp;amp; Operations&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define and implement the UK commercial development strategy jointly with the CEO.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Oversee the UK financial performance, budgeting, and resource allocation to ensure sustainable profitability. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers \u00e0 acc\u00e9der instantan\u00e9ment \u00e0 une information fiable, sourc\u00e9e \u00e0 partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;D\u00e9j\u00e0 d\u00e9ploy\u00e9 avec succ\u00e8s en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage \u00e0 l&#39;\u00e9chelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des \u00e9valuations, am\u00e9lioration continue de nos mod\u00e8les et de leurs qualit\u00e9s et d\u00e9ploiement et int\u00e9gration d\u2019agents autonomes RH.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e d\u00e9veloppeur.se, nous avons besoin d&#39;un.e &quot;&lt;strong&gt;Builder&lt;\/strong&gt;&quot; : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin m\u00e9tier en solution technique, de l\u2019impl\u00e9menter, la qualifier, la d\u00e9ployer et la maintenir dans le temps.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;\ud83c\udfaf VOTRE MISSION&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous recherchons un(e) &lt;strong&gt;AI Engineer confirm\u00e9(e)&lt;\/strong&gt; pour participer activement \u00e0 l&#39;industrialisation et au d\u00e9veloppement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins m\u00e9tiers RH en fonctionnalit\u00e9s IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour relever ce d\u00e9fi, vous \u00e9voluerez au &lt;strong&gt;sein d&#39;un collectif d\u00e9di\u00e9&lt;\/strong&gt;, en collaboration directe avec d&#39;autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d&#39;architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximit\u00e9 vous permettra d&#39;assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l&#39;impl\u00e9mentation technique.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Vous aurez notamment un r\u00f4le cl\u00e9 dans l&#39;\u00e9volution de DaiLY : passer d&#39;un mod\u00e8le de simple consultation (Q&amp;amp;A) \u00e0 un &lt;strong&gt;v\u00e9ritable syst\u00e8me agentique transactionnel&lt;\/strong&gt; capable de d\u00e9clencher des actions concr\u00e8tes (ex : poser des cong\u00e9s dans Workday, s&#39;inscrire \u00e0 des formations via Decathlon University).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83d\udee0 VOS RESPONSABILITES&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9veloppement Agentique &amp;amp; Fonctionnalit\u00e9s&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participer \u00e0 l&#39;extension des capacit\u00e9s de DaiLY vers des actions d&#39;\u00e9criture (write actions) en impl\u00e9mentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Impl\u00e9menter des strat\u00e9gies avanc\u00e9es de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les r\u00e8gles sp\u00e9cifiques au domaine RH.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribuer \u00e0 l&#39;optimisation des co\u00fbts, de la latence et de l&#39;efficacit\u00e9 globale du syst\u00e8me en lien avec les \u00e9quipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Qualit\u00e9, \u00c9valuation &amp;amp; Observabilit\u00e9 (LLMOps)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9velopper et maintenir la couche de qualit\u00e9 du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search \/ Discovery Engine).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des r\u00e9ponses et la v\u00e9rification des citations pour garantir la tra\u00e7abilit\u00e9 vers une source de v\u00e9rit\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mettre en place des pipelines d&#39;observabilit\u00e9 robustes pour l&#39;\u00e9valuation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coder des \u00e9valuateurs automatiques bas\u00e9s sur des golden datasets pour it\u00e9rer sereinement et pr\u00e9venir les r\u00e9gressions avant chaque mise en production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Int\u00e9grer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour prot\u00e9ger le syst\u00e8me et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;S\u00e9curit\u00e9, Cloisonnement &amp;amp; D\u00e9ploiement International&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Access Management (ACLs) : Impl\u00e9menter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d&#39;acc\u00e8s au niveau de l&#39;indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu&#39;un collaborateur n&#39;acc\u00e8de strictement qu&#39;aux documents RH de son p\u00e9rim\u00e8tre.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Isolation &amp;amp; Multi-tenancy : Mettre en \u0153uvre des strat\u00e9gies de filtrage par m\u00e9tadonn\u00e9es (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et\/ou des mod\u00e8les) pour assurer une \u00e9tanch\u00e9it\u00e9 parfaite des donn\u00e9es entre les diff\u00e9rentes soci\u00e9t\u00e9s fiscales, entit\u00e9s l\u00e9gales et g\u00e9ographies de Decathlon.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support Multilingue : Contribuer \u00e0 l&#39;architecture d&#39;internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l&#39;embedding et l&#39;inf\u00e9rence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversit\u00e9 de langues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Produit &amp;amp; Impact Business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Aider \u00e0 l&#39;analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l&#39;impact de DaiLY.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Traduire, avec l&#39;appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux m\u00e9tier en comportements de mod\u00e8les et en m\u00e9triques de succ\u00e8s.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83e\udde0 PROFIL RECHERCHE&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d\u2019une premi\u00e8re exp\u00e9rience.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Exp\u00e9rience :&lt;\/strong&gt; Profil confirm\u00e9 justifiant de plusieurs ann\u00e9es d&#39;exp\u00e9rience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orient\u00e9 IA. Vous justifiez \u00e9galement d&#39;au moins une exp\u00e9rience concr\u00e8te et r\u00e9ussie de mise en production d&#39;un syst\u00e8me GenAI ou agentique.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stack Technique&lt;\/strong&gt; : Solide ma\u00eetrise de Python, de l&#39;\u00e9cosyst\u00e8me GCP \/ Vertex AI, et des frameworks d&#39;orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ADK).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Expertise LLM &amp;amp; Agentique &lt;\/strong&gt;: Solide ma\u00eetrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avanc\u00e9e de m\u00e9tadonn\u00e9es), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function\/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte\/m\u00e9moire.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Qualit\u00e9 &amp;amp; \u00c9valuation&lt;\/strong&gt; : Capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 diagnostiquer une r\u00e9ponse incorrecte (probl\u00e8me de mod\u00e8le, de &lt;em&gt;retrieval&lt;\/em&gt; ou de donn\u00e9es) et app\u00e9tence pour l&#39;observabilit\u00e9 applicative (SQL \/ BigQuery \/ MLflow).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Langues &lt;\/strong&gt;: Fran\u00e7ais courant obligatoire &amp;amp; anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Les plus :&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exp\u00e9rience de traitement multimodal de documents ou dans des \u00e9cosyst\u00e8mes SIRH (ex: Workday).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Compr\u00e9hension technique des enjeux de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqu\u00e9s aux LLMs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d&#39;APIs.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf81 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;L&#39;opportunit\u00e9 de d\u00e9velopper un produit d&#39;IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien de 100 000 collaborateurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud \/ Vertex AI \/ Databricks).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une politique de t\u00e9l\u00e9travail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux \u00e0 Paris - Canal de l\u2019Ourcq).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une culture du &lt;em&gt;delivery&lt;\/em&gt; You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region\u2019s most strategic customer opportunities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, contributors as the business grows.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a If some of this describes you, we\u2019d love to talk.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are a builder who is energized by the opportunity to create a market, design an organization, and turn an ambitious regional strategy into a scaled business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You lead from the front, combining executive presence and strategic thinking with a willingness to engage deeply in customers, opportunities, and execution.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You create clarity and accountability while giving talented people the trust, coaching, and support required to perform at their best.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are comfortable making decisions in an environment where demand, customer requirements, capacity, and priorities are evolving rapidly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You build durable customer relationships by combining commercial ambition with technical curiosity, transparency, and consistent follow-through.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You think beyond an individual transaction and seek to establish CoreWeave as a long-term strategic partner to the customers and markets you serve.Why CoreWeave?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization&#39;s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Family-level Medical Insurance&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Family-level Dental Insurance&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Generous Pension Contribution&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Life Assurance at 4x Salary&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Critical Illness Cover&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Employee Assistance Programme&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Tuition Reimbursement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work culture focused on innovative disruption&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Benefits may vary by location.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Equal Opportunity&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Recruitment Agencies&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;em data-stringify-type=&quot;italic&quot;&gt;CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp;amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;em data-stringify-type=&quot;italic&quot;&gt;Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us \u2013 that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy \u2013 will be considered by us to be a \u201cfree gift\u201d, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate\u2019s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate\u2019s details also be submitted by any other party.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Export Control Compliance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This position requires access to export controlled information. &amp;nbsp;To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. \u00a7 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. \u00a7 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. &amp;nbsp;CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;Updated privacy notice - (\u201cController\u201d), which is located at&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller\u2019s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller\u2019s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong><u>Location: <\/u><\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">US-based, Remote East Coast<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>The impact you will have<\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>Within a year you are successful if<\/h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><\/li><\/ul><h2>What you will be doing<\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Audit.<\/strong> Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Close and reporting.<\/strong> Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. IonQ\u2019s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;amp;index=8&amp;amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Amazon Web Services, &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=and&amp;amp;index=9&amp;amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;and &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;amp;index=10&amp;amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;AstraZeneca&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot; data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What to expect&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a proven architect of complex, multi-domain instruments, whether from space systems, astronomical instrumentation, scientific or medical imaging, electron or advanced optical microscopy, semiconductor equipment, or comparable fields who can bring that system-level rigour to our platform.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot; data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;TextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0&quot; data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;NormalTextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0&quot;&gt;What you&#39;ll be doing&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In this role, you will be an integral part of the development process for IDQ&#39;s SNSPD platform, with applications across quantum computing, networking, and sensing. You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24\/7 detector operations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead system architecture, design decisions, and cross-functional alignment to ensure a scalable and high-performing SNSPD platform&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive technology roadmap, integration, and innovation by evaluating and implementing new technologies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;What you&#39;ll bring&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking an experienced professional with a Master&#39;s degree (PhD preferred) in physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in the design of complex, multi-domain systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture. The ideal candidate has architected instruments or platforms of comparable complexity, combining optics or photonics with electronics, mechanics or thermal design, and embedded or software components and has proven experience integrating these technologies into cohesive, high-performing products.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will demonstrate strong technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to clearly communicate complex system architectures to a wide range of stakeholders. This includes ensuring alignment, supporting informed decision-making, and driving successful collaboration across functions to deliver robust and scalable system designs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extensive experience in system architecture and multi-domain integration, with strong system-level thinking&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven technical leadership and communication skills, enabling alignment and effective decision-making across diverse teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;s1&quot;&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background in domains of comparable complexity: space instrumentation, astronomy, high-end microscopy or imaging, semiconductor or scientific equipment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with photonics, low-noise electronics, cryogenics, or vacuum systems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with SNSPDs, single-photon detection, or quantum systems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience bringing industrialized or rack-mountable systems to market&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. You are passionate about automation and continuously removing manual effort through tooling, scripting and intelligent workflows.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;8+ years of production engineering experience with recent hands-on responsibility for enterprise-scale CI\/CD platforms, Infrastructure as Code and production automation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proven experience embedding security into software delivery through automated scanning, policy enforcement, vulnerability management and measurable operational improvements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Strong scripting and automation skills, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complex operational processes through reusable tooling and automation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You have deep expertise in modern software supply-chain security, internal developer platforms and secure software delivery. You understand how to balance developer productivity with governance, compliance and operational resilience, while creating platforms that engineering teams enjoy using.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You bring practical experience of AI-enabled software delivery, modern release engineering and cloud-native platform design, with a passion for building secure, scalable and highly automated engineering ecosystems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proven expertise in software supply-chain security, including artefact signing, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), provenance and SLSA principles.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience designing internal developer platforms, self-service engineering capabilities and release management processes, including expedited production releases.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Hands-on experience with agentic automation, AI or LLM security, and intelligent workflow orchestration within modern DevSecOps environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1919&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS in C\/C++\/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode\/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C\/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP\/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C\/C++\/Rust skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. IonQ\u2019s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;amp;index=8&amp;amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Amazon Web Services, &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=and&amp;amp;index=9&amp;amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;and &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;amp;index=10&amp;amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;AstraZeneca&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What to Expect&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking a &lt;strong&gt;Senior Mechanical Engineer&lt;\/strong&gt; to join our R&amp;amp;D team in Geneva. In this hands-on role, you will design, validate, and continuously improve mechanical enclosures and subsystems that integrate optical and electronic components for our quantum products.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will take ownership of mechanical solutions from early prototyping through to industrialized product release, with a strong focus on delivering compact, robust, and cost-effective designs. Your work will ensure compliance with dimensional, thermal, and manufacturability requirements, including for highly demanding applications such as cryogenic systems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll be Doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be responsible for the mechanical development of cutting-edge quantum systems, translating requirements into detailed designs and verified assemblies. This includes 3D modelling and documentation, engineering calculations and simulations, and hands-on testing to validate thermal dissipation and mechanical performance. You will collaborate closely with optical, electronic, and system engineers to optimise interfaces and block specifications, and you will engage with external suppliers to prototype and manufacture parts efficiently. As a senior contributor, you will help improve design practices, promote a rigorous engineering approach, and support multiple projects as a mechanical subject-matter expert.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own mechanical design from prototype to industrialised product, including CAD documentation, assembly bring-up, and validation testing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive thermal management (heat sinking, conduction\/convection, interfaces and materials), dimensional stability, and manufacturability through design, simulation, and optimization, working closely with cross-functional teams and suppliers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Perform thermal simulation to predict temperatures, gradients, and heat flows; correlate models with lab measurements and iterate designs and their optimization accordingly&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll Bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor\u2019s or Master\u2019s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Microtechnology, or equivalent, and at least five years of relevant experience in mechanical design and product development. You have hands-on experience designing with sheet metal and\/or machined parts, and a strong ability to develop thermal dissipation solutions for compact systems. Familiarity with cryogenic systems is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are rigorous, organised, and proactive, able to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and Agile environment. Strong communication skills are essential, with fluency in English required; French is considered a plus.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid mechanical engineering foundation with proven experience delivering compact, industrial-grade designs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Structured, collaborative engineer with strong communication skills and a hands-on approach to validation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Knowledge of applicable norms and compliance requirements, including EMC and electrical\/product safety aspects&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit if:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You bring a track record of taking ownership of mechanical subsystems across multiple development phases\u2014requirements, design, verification, and industrialisation\u2014and you are comfortable acting as the mechanical reference point within a multidisciplinary R&amp;amp;D team. Experience with compact thermal management and exposure to cryogenic constraints are strong assets.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental\/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend.
